title: When Skills Fail to Compose: Compatibility and Retention in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skill acquisition alone does not establish a reusable skill library: task proficiency does not specify a compositional interface. Motivated by agents that acquire and refine skills, we study independently learned soft-prompt skills on frozen language models, with skill identities and execution order supplied. Across four digit-task bases and three record-editing models, mean composition accuracy in one call is at most 7.6%, compared with 88.2% to 100% over two calls that add computation and an explicit intermediate output. Neutral-insertion training improves robustness but leaves substantial interference, which block length and per-token norm alone cannot explain on two of four digit bases. translated_title: 当技能无法组合时：语言模型中的兼容性与保留性
translated_abstract: 仅靠技能习得并不能建立一个可复用的技能库：任务熟练度并不等于一个可组合的接口。受能够习得并精炼技能的智能体启发，我们在冻结的语言模型上研究了独立学习的软提示技能，其中技能身份与执行顺序是预先给定的。在四个数字任务基础和三个记录编辑模型上，单次调用的平均组合准确率最高仅为7.6%，而两次调用（增加了计算量和显式的中间输出）的准确率可达88.2%至100%。中性插入训练提升了鲁棒性，但仍然存在大量干扰，在四个数字基础中的两个上，仅凭块长度和每token范数无法解释这种干扰。相同操作的技能块不一定可以互换：在与冻结的已学习伙伴块一同训练后，对两个Qwen基础的事后测试表明，用独立学习的相同操作块替换这些伙伴块会降低中位数兼容性。
tldr: 该论文发现，在冻结语言模型上独立学习的软提示技能难以在单次调用中有效组合（准确率最高仅7.6%，远低于两次调用的88.2%–100%），且相同操作的技能块并不必然可互换，揭示了构建可复用技能库时兼容性与保留性方面的关键瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Independently learned soft-prompt skills on frozen language models fail to compose in a single call (accuracy at most 7.6% vs. 88.2–100% over two calls), and blocks of the same operation are not necessarily interchangeable, revealing key compatibility and retention barriers to building reusable skill libraries.
